release_notes: Request-aware LLM model analytics, comparison, and selection engine
Catalog ingestion from OpenRouter and LiteLLM with deterministic merge
Token and cost estimation with Decimal precision and provider pricing models
Workload scenario evaluation and Pareto-optimal model selection
Reproducible benchmark runner with deterministic evaluators and LLM-as-judge support
Persistent observation storage with SQLite and in-memory backends
Interactive CLI (model-compass) with version, doctor, comparison, selection, and benchmark commands
Safe execution pipeline with LiteLLM backend and cost reconciliation
